summary_en: Introduces PA-SfM, a tracker-free differentiable acoustic structure-from-motion framework that recovers relative sensor-array poses directly from photoacoustic measurements and jointly reconstructs multi-view 3D photoacoustic volumes. The latest bioRxiv revision reports genuine freehand human-hand vascular imaging, in-vivo rat validation, mechanically scanned experiments, expanded-field-of-view mapping, and open-source code.
